actions.description: Inspect host, service, and builder dir
actions.command: cat /etc/os-release; echo "---"; systemctl status builder-app.service 2>&1 | head -20; echo "---"; ls -la /opt/builder/ 2>&1; echo "---"; which python3 python; echo "---"; cat /opt/builder/app.py 2>&1
